# Tallow CRM Subscription Agreement (excerpt)

Customer: Brightfield Housing Trust
Vendor: Tallow Software GmbH
Initial term: 1 November 2025 to 31 October 2026
Agreement reference: TSW-BHT-2025-114

## 2. Definitions

2.1 "Named User Seat" means a licence assigned to one identified individual. Seats
may be reassigned between individuals but the assigned count is what is invoiced.
2.2 "Renewal Term" means each successive twelve (12) month period beginning at the
end of the Initial Term or of a preceding Renewal Term.
2.3 "Edition" means the Tallow Housing Edition, including the Case, Repairs and
Tenancy modules as configured at the Effective Date.

## 3. Fees

3.1 Subscription fees for the Initial Term: 60 named user seats at EUR 800 per seat
per year, total EUR 48,000, invoiced annually in advance.
3.2 Fees for any Renewal Term will be Vendor's then-current list price for the
Customer's Edition and seat count, unless otherwise agreed in writing.
3.3 Seat count may be reduced only with effect from the start of a Renewal Term and
only if requested in writing before the notice deadline in clause 9.2.
3.4 Additional seats purchased mid-term are charged pro rata at the then-current
list price and co-terminate with the current term.

## 4. Invoicing and payment

4.1 Invoices are issued in advance of each term.
4.2 Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.
4.3 Late payment interest accrues at 4% above base rate.

## 5. Support

5.1 Standard support is included: business hours, next business day response for
priority 3, four hours for priority 1.
5.2 Vendor will use reasonable endeavours to maintain 99.5% availability measured
monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.
5.3 Service credits for missed availability are capped at 5% of the annual fee.

## 6. Data

6.1 Customer data remains the property of Customer.
6.2 On termination or expiry, Vendor will make Customer data available for export
in CSV and JSON for ninety (90) days, after which it is deleted.
6.3 Vendor processes personal data as processor under the terms of Annex 2.

## 7. Intellectual property

7.1 Nothing in this Agreement transfers ownership of the Software.
7.2 Customer configurations, reports and templates remain Customer's.

## 8. Liability

8.1 Neither party excludes liability for death, personal injury or fraud.
8.2 Otherwise each party's aggregate liability is capped at the fees paid in the
twelve months preceding the claim.

## 9. Term and termination

9.1 This Agreement renews automatically for successive twelve (12) month Renewal
Terms.
9.2 Either party may prevent renewal by giving written notice of non-renewal at
least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term.
9.3 Notices under this clause must be sent by email to contracts@tallow.example
and are effective on receipt.
9.4 Either party may terminate for material breach that remains uncured sixty (60)
days after written notice of the breach.
9.5 Termination does not relieve Customer of the obligation to pay fees already
invoiced for the then-current term.

## 11. General

11.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the Federal Republic of Germany.
11.2 Neither party may assign without the other's written consent, not to be
unreasonably withheld.
11.3 Amendments must be in writing and signed by both parties.

- Contract: 60 seats at €800/seat = €48k/year, renews automatically unless 30-day notice given
- Current date: 17 Sep 2026, contract ends 31 Oct 2026 → notice deadline is 1 Oct (14 days away)
- Actual usage: 60 seats assigned, only 38 active in last 30 days
- Vendor won't provide pricing until early October (after notice deadline)
- If they don't give notice, it auto-renews at "then-current list price"

# Tallow CRM renewal: renew at 40 seats, not 60

**The recommendation:** Give notice by 1 October to terminate the current agreement, then negotiate a new 40-seat contract for 1 November at known pricing. Do not let it auto-renew.

---

**AT A GLANCE**

| Decision deadline | Current cost | Seats paid vs used | Estimated next-year cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 Oct (14 days) | €48k for 60 seats | 60 assigned, 38 active | €52.8k if auto-renewed at 60 |

---

## 01. We are paying for 22 seats nobody uses

August usage data:
- 60 seats assigned
- 38 active in the last 30 days
- 22 inactive (37% waste)

Finance has 8 seats, 3 active. Fundraising has 7 seats, 2 active. Even allowing headroom for peaks, 40 seats covers current load with 5% spare.

At an assumed €880/seat (10% increase), dropping to 40 seats saves **€17.6k annually** compared to auto-renewing at 60.

---

## 02. Auto-renewal locks us in at unknown pricing

The contract auto-renews on 1 November unless we give 30 days' notice (deadline: 1 October). Renewal pricing is "Vendor's then-current list price" — no cap, no negotiation lever once renewed.

Tallow's account manager will not provide pricing until early October, after the notice window closes. If we stay silent, we are committed to whatever number arrives in the invoice.

---

## 03. Giving notice does not mean switching vendor

Termination notice prevents auto-renewal. It does not terminate support or require a migration. The contract allows a new agreement to start immediately after the old one expires.

The sequence:
1. Notice sent by 1 Oct → current term ends 31 Oct as planned
2. Pricing published early Oct → we negotiate a 40-seat deal
3. New contract starts 1 Nov → no service interruption

If Tallow will not negotiate, we have four weeks to evaluate alternatives before the current term expires. Right now we have no leverage and no number.

---

## 04. Operational risk is low

Aisha's team depends on the Repairs module, especially in winter. This proposal does not disrupt that:
- Same vendor, same modules, same data
- Seat reduction affects unused licences (Finance, Fundraising, Leadership)
- Housing Services (22 assigned, 17 active) and Tenant Repairs (18 assigned, 15 active) are untouched

The alternative — paying €17k/year for seats nobody logs into — does not make the system more reliable.

---

## 05. The board pack placeholder is too high

Marek's FY27 draft (due 8 Oct) assumes €52.8k at 60 seats. If we renew at 40 seats and pricing rises 10%, the actual cost is **€35.2k**, freeing €17.6k for reallocation or saving.

Letting an estimate become a commitment wastes budget we do not need to waste.

---

**NEXT STEP**

Draft termination notice to contracts@tallow.example today, send by 25 September to preserve the deadline buffer. When Tallow publishes October pricing, counter with a 40-seat proposal. If they refuse, the Cobbleworth option (last quoted at £31k for similar scope) is still available and we have four weeks to decide.

---

**NOT IN SCOPE**
- Vendor switch (this is a seat-reduction negotiation, not a migration project)  
- Mid-term changes (seats can only be reduced at renewal)  
- Alternative CRM evaluation (Cobbleworth noted as fallback only)
